title: Network and racks
note: Networking gear: ports, power over Ethernet and rack mounting.

net_ports.label: Network Ports
net_ports.note: Network gear (a wire_role that starts net_): how many Cat6 cables it takes. A router: its LAN ports (the dish or yagi that feeds it goes in its WAN port, which is not counted). docs/INTERNET.md.

poe.label: PoE Ports
poe.note: A switch or injector whose ports each give 15 W of DC power over the cable: a camera, an access point or a yagi on one of them needs no other supply.

poe_powered.label: Runs From PoE
poe_powered.note: A network device that takes its power from the cable (a camera, an access point, a yagi): it is cabled only to a PoE port, and everything else only to a standard port.

rack_units.label: Rack Units
rack_units.note: A rackmount router or switch: the units it takes in a wall rack (1). 0 = it does not go in a rack.

rack_capacity_u.label: Rack Capacity (U)
rack_capacity_u.note: A rack (wire_role net_rack): the units it holds. The gear in it is cabled as one device: its ports add up.
